readOnly: You have read-only access to this environment.
viewLoadFailed: This environment could not be opened. Reload the page to try again.
loadRecovery: Your environment is still available. Try loading its configuration again.
unsaved: You have unsaved configuration or layout changes. Return to Configuration to continue editing.
observationFailed: Runtime observations could not be refreshed. Any observations shown are from the last successful request.
deploymentNote: Saving configuration does not deploy it. Review a deployment plan before applying changes.
drift: The last observation detected infrastructure changes. Review them in Deployments before applying a plan.
omitted_one: {{count}} resource was omitted from the observation.
omitted_other: {{count}} resources were omitted from the observation.
conflictNotice: Another revision is ready to compare. Your edits are preserved. Open Configuration to review and merge them before saving.
savedServices: Services in the saved configuration. Observations describe the last reported runtime state.
emptyDescription: Open Configuration to add your first service and connect its resources.
emptyCompose: Open Configuration to edit and preview your Compose files. Services appear here after the configuration is saved.
emptyReadOnly: Services will appear here after a workspace administrator saves the configuration.
configurationDescription: Review and edit this environment’s configuration. Saving a revision does not deploy it.

configurationEditor.reloadNotApplied: The current revision was fetched, but your newer edits were kept. Reload again when you are ready to discard them.
configurationEditor.invalidJson: Enter valid JSON before saving. Your edits have been kept.
configurationEditor.advancedNotice: Save the advanced specification before returning to the visual editor.
configurationEditor.reloadDescription: Reloading replaces your specification edits with the current saved revision. Canvas positions are kept.
configurationEditor.comparisonDescription: Inspect this saved revision alongside your editor text. Comparing does not change your save base.
configurationEditor.conflictDescription: Your edits are still in the editor. Compare them with the current server revision, then merge your changes before saving again.
configurationEditor.acknowledge: I have compared and merged my edits
configurationEditor.merged: Your edits are preserved and will be saved on top of the compared revision.

visualEditor.emptyDescription: Add a service below to start connecting your environment.
visualEditor.networkDescription: This network is defined in the Compose files. Edit them to change which services join it.
visualEditor.selectDescription: Choose a service or data volume to inspect its configuration.

lifecycle.retireDescription: Take this environment off its server and make it read-only. Its configuration and data volumes are kept, so you can restore it later.
lifecycle.retireDialogDescription: Retiring makes this environment read-only until it is restored. When you retire it:

retireEffects.routes: Its routes and domains stop being served from its server.
retireEffects.services: Its services (containers) and networks are removed from the server.
retireEffects.volumes: Its named data volumes are kept on the server.
retireEffects.credentials: Its automation tokens are revoked. Restoring it does not bring them back.
retireEffects.policies: Its preview, terminal session and backup policies are turned off, and open terminal sessions are closed.
retireEffects.previews: Live pull-request previews created from this template are cleaned up.
retireEffects.kept: Its configuration, revisions, history and secrets are kept.

lifecycle.restoreDialogDescription: Restoring makes this environment active again as configuration only:

restoreEffects.nothingDeployed: Nothing is deployed. Review and apply a deployment plan to run it again.
restoreEffects.staysOff: Automation tokens stay revoked, and its preview, terminal session and backup policies stay off until you turn them back on.
restoreEffects.volumes: The next deployment reuses its kept volumes. It stops with a conflict if another environment now uses one of its hostnames.

lifecycle.purgeDialogDescription: This cannot be undone, and the environment cannot be restored afterwards. When you delete its retained data:

purgeEffects.volumes: Its server is asked to delete these data volumes:
purgeEffects.noVolumes: It keeps no data volumes, so nothing is deleted from its server.
purgeEffects.revoked: If its server has been revoked, it is not contacted, and these volumes stay on it.
purgeEffects.previews: Its previews hold copies of its secrets, so each must be deleted first. Wait for its cleanup, or choose Remove preview and data on it under Previews:
purgeEffects.noPreviews: None of its previews holds copies of its secrets.
purgeEffects.secrets: The values of its secrets are erased, for every version.
purgeEffects.kept: Its configuration, revisions and history are kept, read-only.
purgeEffects.backups: Backups at the workspace’s backup destination are kept.

lifecycle.nameMismatch: The name does not match this environment’s current name. Check it and try again.
lifecycle.forbidden: Only workspace owners can retire or restore environments, or delete their retained data.
lifecycle.mfa: Set up two-factor authentication in Account security, then try again.
lifecycle.verifyEmail: Verify your email address in Account security, then try again.
lifecycle.subscription: An active workspace subscription is required. Open Workspace to finish setup.
lifecycle.recentAuth: Confirm your identity, then try again.
lifecycle.unavailable: This environment is no longer available. It may have been deleted, or you may no longer have access to it.

refusal.activeOperation: Another operation is running for this environment. Wait for it to finish or cancel it, then try again.
refusal.serverBusy: Another operation is running on this environment’s server. Try again when it finishes.
refusal.upgrade: A database upgrade holds this environment’s data. Finish or return the upgrade and wait for its retention period to end, then try again.
refusal.cutover: A backup restore cutover is waiting to be deployed. Deploy it or replace the draft, then try again.
refusal.crossHost: This environment runs on more than one server. Consolidate it onto its primary server and deploy it without a placement, then try again.
refusal.replacement: This environment’s replacement deployment did not finish, and the server it replaced is no longer revoked, so both may run it. Finish the replacement deployment or revoke the former server, then try again.
refusal.agentUpdate: Update this server’s agent before retiring environments on it.
refusal.serverTransfer: This environment’s server is waiting for a verified agent transfer. Complete the transfer, then try again.
refusal.state: This environment’s state has changed, so this can no longer be done. The page now shows its current state.
refusal.volumes: The volumes this environment keeps have changed. Check the updated list, then confirm again.
refusal.purgeAgentUpdate: Update this server’s agent before deleting retained data on it.
refusal.previews: Some of this template’s previews are not deleted yet. Each is listed above with what it is waiting for.
refusal.unknown: This environment cannot be changed right now. Check its current state, then try again.

lifecycle.retirementStarted: Retirement started. The environment is read-only while its server removes it.
lifecycle.restored: Environment restored. Nothing has been deployed.
lifecycle.purgeStarted: Deleting retained data. Its secret values are erased, and its server is deleting its volumes.
lifecycle.purgedWithoutHost: Secret values erased. Its server was revoked, so its volumes were not deleted.

status.purgingTitle: This environment’s retained data is being deleted
status.purgedTitle: This environment’s retained data is deleted
status.purgedWithoutHostTitle: This environment’s secret values are erased, but its volumes were not deleted
status.retiredDescription: It is read-only. Its routes, services and networks are no longer on its server.
status.retiringDescription: It is read-only while its server removes its routes, services and networks.
status.purgingDescription: It is read-only and cannot be restored. Its secret values are erased, and its server is deleting its kept volumes.
status.purgedDescription: It is read-only and cannot be restored. Its data volumes were deleted from its server, and its secret values were erased.
status.purgedNoVolumesDescription: It is read-only and cannot be restored. It kept no data volumes, and its secret values were erased.
status.purgedWithoutHostDescription: It is read-only and cannot be restored. Its secret values were erased.
status.purgeRequestedByYou: You asked to delete its retained data on {{date}}.
status.purgeRequestedBy: <person/> asked to delete its retained data on {{date}}.
status.purgeRequestedByOwner: An owner asked to delete its retained data on {{date}}.
status.withoutHost: A server it ran on had been revoked, so that server was not contacted. This environment’s containers may still be running there.
status.purgedWithoutHost: Its server had been revoked, so that server was not contacted. The volumes below may still be on it and must be removed there by hand.
status.backupsKept: Backups at the workspace’s backup destination are kept.
status.operationFailed: The state of the removal could not be loaded.
status.retryHint: Removal did not finish. Retry retirement to queue it again.
status.purgeOperationFailed: The state of the deletion could not be loaded.
status.purgeRetryHint: Deletion did not finish. Delete retained data again to queue it again.
status.remainingVolumesTitle: Volumes that may remain on the server
status.volumesFailed: Kept volumes could not be loaded.
status.previewsFailed: This template’s previews could not be loaded.
status.volumesEmpty: This environment has no kept volumes.
status.ownersOnly: Only workspace owners can restore it or delete its retained data.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.description: Values are write-only. Reference a version ID in your specification with <field/>.
secrets.tooShortToCheck: Too short to check: this value is shorter than 12 bytes, so files you submit and public build arguments are not checked for it. Save a value of 12 or more characters to have them checked.
secrets.name: Secret name
secrets.hint: Reusing a name adds a version. You’ll be asked to confirm your identity before saving.
secrets.saved: Secret version saved. Its value cannot be read back.
secrets.savedTooShort: Secret version saved. Its value cannot be read back. It is shorter than 12 bytes, so files you submit and public build arguments are not checked for it. Use 12 or more characters to have them checked.
secrets.retired: Secret {{name}} retired. The values of all its versions are erased.
secrets.versionRetired: Version {{id}} of {{name}} retired. Its value is erased.
secrets.retireDialogDescription: Retiring a secret cannot be undone. When you retire it:

retireEffects.values: The value of every version is erased.
retireEffects.name: It leaves this list, and its name can be used for a new secret.
retireEffects.revisions: Earlier revisions that use it can no longer be deployed.

secrets.retireDialogInUse: A secret cannot be retired while the draft, the running deployment, a deployment plan, an operation or a database upgrade uses one of its versions.
secrets.retireVersionDialogDescription: Retiring version {{id}} cannot be undone. When you retire it:

retireVersionEffects.value: Its value is erased, and files you submit and public build arguments are no longer checked against it.
retireVersionEffects.current: The secret keeps its current version and its other versions.
retireVersionEffects.revisions: Earlier revisions that use this version can no longer be deployed.

secrets.retireVersionDialogInUse: A version cannot be retired while the draft, the running deployment, a deployment plan, an operation or a database upgrade uses it.

refusal.inUse: This secret is still in use. The draft, the running deployment, a deployment plan, an operation or a database upgrade uses one of its versions. Replace it there, then try again.
refusal.versionInUse: This version is still in use. The draft, the running deployment, a deployment plan, an operation or a database upgrade uses it. Replace it there, then try again.
refusal.current: This is now the secret’s current version. Save a new value to replace it, or retire the secret.
refusal.inactive: This environment is no longer active, so its secrets cannot be changed. The page now shows its current state.
refusal.unknown: This secret cannot be retired right now. Check the environment’s current state, then try again.
refusal.forbidden: Only workspace owners can retire secrets.
refusal.mfa: Set up two-factor authentication in Account security, then try again.
refusal.verifyEmail: Verify your email address in Account security, then try again.
refusal.subscription: An active workspace subscription is required. Open Workspace to finish setup.
refusal.recentAuth: Confirm your identity, then try again.
refusal.unavailable: This secret is no longer available. It may have been retired already.
refusal.versionUnavailable: This version is no longer available. It may have been retired already.
